messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-06-16] handover/2025-06-16-catalog: Boreal is taking over the catalog from team Dune, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-catalog: From today the pager for the catalog service rings Dune, not the Cinder team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-04-15] standup/dune/2025-04-15: If image-resizer is down, the product catalog is down: it relies on it for thumbnails.
- [2025-04-29] handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer: The Ember team is taking over the image resizer from team Dune, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-03-24] standup/dune/2025-03-24: Reminder that the product catalog only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. Farah still has the Dune pager.
- [2025-05-05] standup/dune/2025-05-05: For newcomers: the deploy window for the catalog is still on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-04-04] standup/dune/2025-04-04: We agreed today that the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. The reason is that the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.
- [2025-12-17] standup/dune/2025-12-17: Decided in today's standup: search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2025-10-31] standup/boreal/2025-10-31: Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29: Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki.
- [2025-01-13] standup/boreal/2025-01-13: Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year.
- [2026-04-23] standup/atlas/2026-04-23: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2026-02-19] standup/boreal/2026-02-19-2: Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-01-14] standup/cinder/2025-01-14: Yuki takes the first team Cinder on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-11-20] handover/2025-11-20-event-bus: Boreal is taking over the bus from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-04-08] standup/cinder/2025-04-08: Reminder that the indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the catalog service.
- [2025-08-29] standup/atlas/2025-08-29: Observation from Atlas: after the client rollout, the product catalog's request volume halved.
- [2026-03-31] standup/ember/2026-03-31: Diego Alvarez has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar. Ember saw that the feature flag service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-10-13] standup/cinder/2025-10-13: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki. Reminder that the search indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-05-08] standup/boreal/2025-05-08: Boreal saw that the catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-04-18] standup/atlas/2025-04-18-2: Heads-up from the Atlas team: the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.
- [2025-02-28] standup/cinder/2025-02-28: Dependency map update: search-indexer needs the product catalog (product documents). Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2026-03-16] standup/boreal/2026-03-16: From today the product catalog deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC instead of on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: The resizer lives with Dune.
- [2025-11-06] standup/dune/2025-11-06-2: Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2025-07-17] standup/dune/2025-07-17: Reminder: Farah is on call for Dune this cycle.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-06-12] standup/dune/2025-06-12: The Dune team noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. Dune sits on the fourth floor.
- [2026-03-04] standup/dune/2026-03-04: The webhook dispatcher remains a team Dune service.
- [2025-10-27] standup/dune/2025-10-27: Reminder from Dune: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Farah.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: The Dune team owns the reporting service.
- [2025-01-16] standup/dune/2025-01-16: First on-call rotation for team Dune goes to Farah Haddad.
- [2026-06-08] standup/dune/2026-06-08: Rotation day for Dune: Tomasz hands the pager to Farah.
- [2025-12-15] standup/dune/2025-12-15: Rotation day for Dune: Tomasz hands the pager to Farah.

Question: When did Dune take over the catalog?

message.reasoning:
The question asks when Dune took over the catalog. Looking at the memory entries about catalog ownership:

- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the catalog service.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-catalog: From today the pager for the catalog service rings Dune, not the Cinder team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-06-16] handover/2025-06-16-catalog: Boreal is taking over the catalog from team Dune, effective today.

So Dune took over the catalog on 2025-03-20.
